title: Robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery versus conventional laparoscopic surgery in randomized controlled trials
author: Hyunsuk Frank Roh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k7ucznw

steps.title: Identify and remove duplicate studies
steps.instruction: Identify duplicate studies across datasets using a Python script and manual verification.

substeps.instruction: Use the CountingDuplicates.py script (converted from .pdf to .py) to identify duplicates.
Manually double-check identified duplicates using the provided worksheet.
Verify that all studies in Cochrane are also present in PubMed or EMBASE.

steps.title: Screen PubMed data
steps.instruction: Perform an initial screening of PubMed data based on title and abstract.

substeps.instruction: Review names and abstracts of studies.
Examine full-texts if the study's relevance is suspected.
Record in the worksheet whether the full-text was available, if the study is an RCT, the language, relevance, and any other comments.

steps.title: Screen EMBASE data
steps.instruction: Perform an initial screening of EMBASE data based on title and abstract.

substeps.instruction: Review names and abstracts of studies.
Examine full-texts in cases of doubt using Web of Science (Core) and SCOPUS to locate the text.
Record in the worksheet which database provided the full text to allow for double-checking by other authors.

steps.title: Resolve study inclusion discrepancies
steps.instruction: Finalize the list of included and excluded studies through senior review and verification.

substeps.instruction: Have the senior author decide on inclusion or exclusion for any discrepancies between the first two authors.
Perform a final double-check of the worksheet.
